title: Single Cloud Sync Control Fix
notes: Fixes duplicate Cloud Sync sections appearing in both the Drill Log and Shot Diagram menus.
Stops the retired m39.8 transfer helper and m39.9 cloud helper from loading alongside the m40 standardized document layer.
Makes m40 the single owner of Drill Log transfer and Cloud Sync controls.
Removes any stale or duplicate Cloud Sync buttons and Cloud menu groups left by an older cached page.
Preserves the m40 shared document contract, cloud data compatibility, PDF cleanup, rotation-aware conversion, and automatic page renumbering.
